能用直径乘 3.14 估计周长
set.description: 知道圆周率是圆的周长与直径的比，计算时可以取 3.14。
set.name: Pi

criteria: 能把小数四舍五入到个位
能保留一位小数
set.description: 会用四舍五入法求小数的近似数，保留整数或一位小数。
set.name: Finding approximate values of decimals

set.reason: Rounding a decimal to a requested precision is directly part of producing the target approximations.
set.scope: Rounding to a specified precision

set.reason: Both circumference formulas use the circle constant pi and its circumference/diameter meaning, or the specified 3.14 approximation.
set.scope: applying C = pi d and C = 2 pi r

set.reason: Per-unit and count models help extend a wheel circumference to many turns, while a single flowerbed circumference uses only its radius/diameter and pi. Keep the useful modeling preparation without making speed or price formulas mandatory.
set.scope: distance equals circumference times number of turns

set.reason: The one-turn or one-lap application explicitly substitutes radius or diameter into a circumference calculation.
set.scope: computing one lap or one turn length

set.reason: Contexts such as price, quantity and total, or speed, time and distance, supply familiar examples. Direct proportion can be learned through other contexts like side length and perimeter.
set.scope: familiar contexts for constant ratio

set.reason: A constant product defines inverse proportion independently of a constant ratio. Direct proportion is useful comparison, without an explicit contrast criterion in the inverse-proportion node itself.
set.scope: contrast with constant-ratio relations

set.reason: The target explicitly forms a proportion and finds its unknown, containing proportion solving as a required final component.
set.scope: setting up and solving the proportion

set.reason: The explicit criterion distinguishes direct from inverse proportion and uses the selected relation. Direct-proportion meaning is necessary for the direct branch and for the stated comparison.
set.scope: judging direct proportion and setting up its proportion

set.reason: The same explicit comparison requires inverse-proportion meaning; calling it merely optional would omit part of the actual criterion.
set.scope: distinguishing direct from inverse proportion

criteria: 能判断绕一周用周长
能代入半径或直径计算
set.description: 能用圆的周长解决车轮滚动、圆形花坛一周的长度等问题。
set.name: Applications of the circumference of a circle

criteria: 能判断两种量成正比例还是反比例
能列出比例并求出未知数
set.description: 能用正比例或反比例的关系列出比例，解决简单的实际问题。
set.name: Solving Practical Problems Using Proportions

criteria: 能根据半径求周长
能根据直径求周长
set.description: 会用直径乘圆周率，或半径的 2 倍乘圆周率，求圆的周长。
set.name: Circumference of a circle

criteria: 会按精确度取近似数
能说出近似数的有效数字个数
set.description: 理解近似数、精确度，会按要求四舍五入取近似数并说出有效数字。
set.name: Approximate Numbers and Significant Figures

criteria: 能说出成正比例的两种量比值一定
能用比值求另一个量
set.description: 认识成正比例的量：一种量扩大几倍，另一种量也扩大几倍，比值一定。
set.name: Direct Proportion

criteria: 能说出成反比例的两种量乘积一定
能用乘积求另一个量
set.description: 认识成反比例的量：一种量扩大几倍，另一种量反而缩小到几分之一，乘积一定。
set.name: Inverse Proportion

criteria: 能把外项之积等于内项之积写成等式
能求出未知项
set.description: 会根据比例的基本性质求比例里的未知项。
set.name: Solving Proportions
